lines: 柴扉最新章节_第83章 布局第1页_柴扉邓子夏_热点小说网
> 第83章 布局（第1页）
从临渊镇回来后的当晚，秦川没有睡觉。
他坐在工作间里，把入谷以来收集到的所有信息铺在桌上。药材清单、弟子名单、各堂口结构图、赵伯的传讯记录、苏木槿绘制的势力分布图、沈青黛整理的禁忌药材名录。这些散乱的碎片在他面前排成一张张等待拼接的拼图。
他需要一张情报网。不是钱不缺那种遍布三界的商业网络，也不是赵伯那种覆盖天地的因果网络。而是一张凡人的网络——由凡人构成、为凡人服务的、扎根在基层的消息传递系统。苏木槿问他为什么要把“蛛网”两个字写在笔记扉页上，他如实告诉她这是致敬因果蛛母朱颜，而这张网的名字叫“蛛网”。
他先画了核心节点。第一个是沈青黛——她在丹堂的位置能接触到药材流向的信息，而药材的异常流动往往能提前反映某个区域的疫情或战事。第二个是药童——他在医馆帮忙，每天经手的病人是最好的信息来源。秦川已经教会了他如何从病人的主诉中提取关键信息并分类记录。第三个是他自己在百草谷建立的人脉——那些来找他请教过问题的弟子，分布在丹堂、针堂、药堂，每个人都是一个微小的信息触点。
然后是外围节点。药童的外派师弟们在周边村镇采药、出诊，他们看到的是基层的真实状况。柳少微回天医宗后虽然暂时没有回信，但外伤急救手册的合作一旦启动，天医宗的弟子也会成为信息源。钱不缺的商会网络是最成熟的信息渠道，但秦川不想过度依赖钱不缺——他的投资迟早有收回的一天，在此之前秦川需要建立属于自己的独立网络。
秦川将这些节点画在一张草纸上，用实线标注已建立的联系，虚线标注潜在的联系。他看着这张简陋的网络图，意识到它的核心价值不是收集机密情报，而是填补信息盲区。中界的宗门高高在上，他们通过灵力和术法可以感知到天地灵气的细微变化，但他们对凡人的死活、凡人的迁移、凡人的需求几乎毫无感知。他的蛛网要做的事情很简单：告诉那些想知道凡人在做什么的人，凡人在做什么，需要什么，哪里有了疫病，哪里出现了反常的异动。
这个目标很低，但正因为低，所以不会引起宗门的警惕。一个收集凡人信息的网络，在修士看来毫无价值。但秦川知道，一旦终焉之疫在中界扩散，这些看起来毫无价值的信息，将是最宝贵的早期预警系统。
他把示意图卷起来，塞进存放私人物品的木箱底层，压在老陆给的磨刀石下面。然后拿起笔，开始给沈青黛写一份药材流向月度统计的提纲。
写完提纲，他搁下笔，走到窗前。竹窗外药田里的虫鸣声依旧，有几株夜光草在月光下泛着淡蓝色的微光。百草谷的夜晚很美，但这份美是脆弱的——就像封印碎裂之前的青山村，越美越脆弱。

他看了一眼枕头下面露出的磨刀石一角，忽然想起王屠户在村口告诉他破军刀名字的那天。王屠户说杀到第七万个的时候，把自己也杀死了。秦川当时不理解——杀念为什么会反噬自身。现在他在中界待久了，开始渐渐明白。不是杀念反噬自身，是孤独。一个人杀了太久之后，就不知道怎么停了。王屠户废了自己的修为，是因为他不想再孤独下去。而秦川现在做的事情，恰恰相反——他在织网，在建立连接，在让自己和更多人产生联系。他不是在做情报工作，他是在用情报工作对抗自己的孤独。
他回到桌前，继续写那份药材流向提纲。墨迹在纸上延伸，像蛛网在夜幕中无声地铺开。

> Chapter 83 Layout (page 1)
The night after returning from Linyuan Town, Qin Chuan did not sleep.
He sat in his workshop and laid out all the information he had collected since entering the valley on the table. The list of medicinal materials, the list of disciples, the structure diagram of each hall, Zhao Bo's summons record, the power distribution map drawn by Su Mujin, and the list of taboo medicinal materials compiled by Shen Qingdai. These scattered pieces were lined up in front of him like puzzle pieces waiting to be pieced together.
He needs an intelligence network. It’s not Qian Buqi’s kind of business network that spans the three realms, nor is it Zhao Bo’s kind of causal network that covers the world. It is a network of mortals - a messaging system rooted in the grassroots, composed of mortals, serving mortals. Su Mujin asked him why he wrote the word "spider web" on the title page of the note. He truthfully told her that it was a tribute to Zhu Yan, the mother of the causal spider, and the name of this web was "spider web".
He drew the core nodes first. The first one is Shen Qingdai - her position in Dan Tang has access to information on the flow of medicinal materials, and the abnormal flow of medicinal materials can often reflect the epidemic or war in a certain area in advance. The second one is the medicine boy - he helps in the medical clinic, and the patients he handles every day are the best source of information. Qin Chuan has taught him how to extract key information from patients' chief complaints and classify them for recording. The third one is the network of people he has established in Baicao Valley - the disciples who have come to him to ask questions are distributed in the Alchemy Hall, the Needle Hall, and the Medicine Hall. Each one of them is a tiny information contact point.
Then there are the peripheral nodes. The younger brothers of Yaotong were dispatched to collect medicines and conduct medical visits in surrounding villages and towns. What they saw was the real situation at the grassroots level. Although Liu Shaowei did not reply for the time being after returning to the Tianyi Sect, once the cooperation on the trauma first aid manual is launched, the disciples of the Tianyi Sect will also become a source of information. The network of chambers of commerce where money is not lacking is the most mature information channel, but Qin Chuan does not want to rely too much on money - his investment will be recovered sooner or later, and before that, Qin Chuan needs to establish his own independent network.
Qinchuan drew these nodes on a piece of paper, using solid lines to mark established connections and dotted lines to mark potential connections. He looked at this rudimentary network diagram and realized that its core value was not to collect confidential intelligence, but to fill in information blind spots. The sects in the Middle Realm are high above. They can sense subtle changes in the aura of heaven and earth through spiritual power and magic, but they have almost no awareness of the life and death of mortals, their migrations, and their needs. The purpose of his spider web is simple: to tell those who want to know what mortals are doing, what they need, where there are diseases, and where there are abnormal movements.
This goal is very low, but precisely because it is low, it will not arouse the sect's vigilance. A network that collects information about mortals is worthless to the monks. But Qin Chuan knew that once the final epidemic spreads in the middle realm, this seemingly worthless information would be the most valuable early warning system.
He rolled up the schematic diagram, stuffed it into the bottom of the wooden box where his personal belongings were stored, and pressed it under the whetstone given by Lao Lu. Then he picked up the pen and began to write an outline of monthly statistics on the flow of medicinal materials to Shen Qingdai.
After writing the outline, he put down his pen and walked to the window. The sound of insects in the medicinal field outside the bamboo window is still there, and a few glow-in-the-dark grasses glow with a light blue glow in the moonlight. The night in Baicao Valley is beautiful, but this beauty is fragile - just like Qingshan Village before the seal was broken, the more beautiful it is, the more fragile it is.
He glanced at the corner of the whetstone exposed under the pillow, and suddenly remembered the day Butcher Wang told him the name of Po Saber at the entrance of the village. Butcher Wang said that when he killed the 70,000, he also killed himself. Qin Chuan didn't understand at the time why the thought of killing would come back to bite him. Now that he has been in the middle realm for a long time, he is beginning to understand. It's not that the murderous thoughts come back to bite me, it's loneliness. After someone has been killing for so long, he doesn't know how to stop. Butcher Wang abandoned his cultivation because he didn't want to be alone anymore. What Qin Chuan is doing now is exactly the opposite - he is weaving a network, establishing connections, and connecting himself with more people. He is not doing intelligence work, he is using intelligence work to combat his loneliness.
He returned to the table and continued to write the outline of the flow of medicinal materials. The ink marks extend on the paper, spreading silently like a spider web in the night.
